basis: Progressive spastic paraplegia, neuropathy and intellectual disability; persistent pes cavus in 100% supports musculoskeletal involvement.
Cortical malformations, severe intellectual disability and developmental delay in all reported patients; seizures are common.
Mature B-cell neoplasm umbrella includes lymphomas and leukemias; no additional organ is consistently damaged across the group.
Mitochondrial disorder spectrum defined by optic atrophy and/or spastic ataxia; expression of the ocular and neurologic components varies by subtype.
Alzheimer neurodegeneration with dementia and neurofibrillary tangles; APOE association alone does not establish systemic metabolic disease.
Clonal Langerhans-cell neoplasm; destructive bone lesions occur in roughly 70-80% and skin lesions in about 30-40% of childhood cases.
Isolated congenital motor nystagmus impairs ocular fixation; the record does not establish additional neurologic disease.
Tick-borne Borrelia infection; mening CNS involvement is uncommon, and transient cytopenias or elevated liver enzymes do not establish common organ damage.
Complement-mediated thrombotic microangiopathy defined by kidney injury, hemolytic anemia and thrombocytopenia; hypertension alone adds no separate organ damage.
Persistent pulmonary vascular hypertension and right-to-left shunting define the disease; hypoxemia alone does not establish lung tissue damage.
Congenital distal joint contractures and limb deformities define the condition; hearing impairment is very rare.
Craniosynostosis and syndactyly define this skeletal malformation umbrella; additional organ damage varies among subtypes.
Primary adamantinoma arising in the tibial bone.
Vaginal epithelial neoplasm; intestinal differentiation does not imply gastrointestinal origin or damage.
Abnormal testicular descent is a reproductive structural disorder; endocrine dysfunction and common renal damage are not established.
Anterior polar cataract in all reported patients, with amblyopia in 16/17.
Reproductive infertility umbrella; an endocrine disorder is not established across the group.
Intellectual disability and central hypotonia define the disorder; scoliosis occurs in 30-79%. Unspecified eye abnormalities do not establish functional damage.
Congenital NAD synthesis deficiency with vertebral/limb and cardiac malformations; renal agenesis affects 2/5, supporting renal involvement at about 40%.
Malignant solid pleuropulmonary tumor arising in lung or pleura; aggressive behavior alone does not establish common distant organ involvement.
Soft tissue sarcoma of skeletal muscle lineage with myoblastic differentiation; alveolar describes histology, not pulmonary origin.
Neurologic movement disorder causing abnormal contractions and postures; contractions alone do not establish intrinsic muscle damage.
T-cell/NK-cell lymphoid malignancy umbrella includes leukemias and lymphomas; no additional organ is consistently involved across subtypes.
Retinal dystrophy, obesity and severe renal disease define this reported phenotype; intellectual disability in 1/1 supports neurologic involvement. Brachydactyly omitted by cap.
Propionate metabolism defect; developmental impairment and neurologic injury affect over 30%, often roughly half or more. Cardiomyopathy generally affects under 30%.
